spots.text: Long live the Queen, who has read every book in the hive, and says they are all the same book.

meta.label: The Hive
meta.blurb: Every cell has a reader's chair in it, or a shelf, or both. The wax is warm. Something, somewhere in the comb, is humming.

secrets.name: The Queen's Chamber
secrets.text: You pushed through the wax at the back of the empty carrel. In the middle of the comb there is one chair, bigger than the others, and one book, bigger than the others.
